summary: Situated in the heart of Penrith, surrounded by a wide range of amenities and shops, within easy walking distance of the railway station, a deceptively spacious and flexible, low maintenance, 1/2 bedroom first floor apartment, ideal as a first time purchase of buy to let.
description:
Offered to the market with no ongoing chain, and found in good well-presented neutral order throughout having just been redecorated, 7a princes Court is a great opportunity to acquire a well-proportioned apartment, located in this popular area of Penrith town centre.

Ideal as a buy to let accusation, having been recently generating a rental income circa £575 PCM, the property would also make a low maintenance home, or with easy access to the rail and bus stations, it would have great potential as a second property to use as a base for exploring the nearby Lake District, with options as a short let, "Air BnB" income generator when not in an owners use.

Occupying the first floor of the building, the property is accessed by a private courtyard and has accommodation comprising the entrance hall, with its own private access, sitting / dining room, modern fitted kitchen, master bedroom, 2nd bedroom / sitting room and a recently upgraded bathroom.

Perfectly positioned, viewing is essential to appreciate.

Directions From the Market Square in the town centre, follow Rowcliffe Lane, which runs between Grahams and the Heart Foundation shop for 60 metres to reach Princes Court on the right hand side.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • Vehicle parking is on road. (Permit required).

Tenure: The property is leasehold, with 969 years remaining in the lease. We are informed there is a ground rent and service charge circa £275.00 PA and building insurance circa £385.00 PA
